<!-- pr-reviewer: 46747abe07bb5cced279cba4c42fd0b69997f21b -->

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

What looks good:
- The merge keeps both sides. The Face raster entry sits beside the hole-order and sinker entries in the MCP params string, the pick capability registry, the capability test and the UI page tests. Four files, no planner logic changed by hand.
- The capability registry now has one exhaustive arm per kind (Face, SinkerBurn, SinkerSideBurn, HoleOrder, Meridian, Slot, Threading, Ring) with no fall-through. Drill, Bore and Thread get `HoleOrder`; Sinker Burn gets `Ring`; Sinker Side Burn gets `Ends`; Slot keeps `Ends`; Wire Contour keeps `Threading`.
- The UI page tests keep both the Face test (states and clears the start/exit on Geometry, undo restores the automatic raster) and main's hole-kinds test.
- No new dependency, no `build.rs`, no `.github/`, no `scripts/`, no `.cargo/`, no `xtask/` change: not a read-only PR. The PR is a collaborator's PR (mkinney, write access), so the runner path was used for the build.

Results merged with main (self-hosted runner, pr-test.yml run 45710592465):
- Trial merge with main succeeded.
- Quick plan: 887 of 933 steps ran on the merged tree. No FAIL and no STALL row. Every other step succeeded or was skipped.
- The run was cancelled at the 90-minute limit (23:38Z, conclusion `cancelled`). The "Quick gate on the merged tree" step was cancelled. The "Clippy on the touched crates" step was skipped because the gate was cancelled. 46 of 933 steps did not run on this head. A cancelled run is no verdict; it is not a pass.
- Local targeted set on this head (per the PR comment, Linux, -j 6): motion `face_start_exit` 14; app `face_start_exit` 10; `contour_start_point` 11; `slot_start_exit` 10; `start_exit_shared` 30; app lib `boundary_turn` 7; ui lib 1688 (8 ignored); `mcp` 52; `mcp_pick` 8; `mcp_wire_contour` 10; `mcp_doc_drift` 6; clippy GREEN.
- Steps 1-252 of the quick plan ran earlier and were green, no FAIL and no STALL.

Targeted tests (step 5):
- Example catalog suites (the diff is a toolpath change): `example_catalog` 43 (4 ignored); `example_catalog_adaptive` 1; `example_catalog_edge_work` 1. All green in the targeted local set.
- Light lane: not run on this head. No result is recorded for the refresh; the base review at e7a7b3582 recorded a green light lane, and the cut gate runs the whole tree before the tag, so this gap is a note, not a blocker.
- No P1 targeted heavy step is owed: the PR is a P2 defect fix (`fix(2d)`, not a wrong-output/safety-floor fix). No heavy record is needed on this head.

Requested before merge: none (blocking).

Notes (not blocking):
- Stale wording in a capability-test panic text: crates/app/tests/start_exit_shared.rs:94. The `_`-arm panic says "only the contour, the wire, the face, the slot and the three turning kinds take a pick". It no longer names the hole-order kinds (Drill, Bore, Thread, #3328) or the sinker kinds (Sinker Burn, Sinker Side Burn, #3333). It is a failure-message string, not a test result: no green test is misled. Suggested fix (one line): "only the contour, the wire, the face, the slot, the three turning kinds, the hole-order kinds and the sinker kinds take a pick".
- The run was cancelled at the timeout, so 46 quick-plan steps did not run on this head. The release cut gate runs the whole tree before the tag.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
